table_name: Table 7E - Requirements for Firefighting Installations - For Business Buildings

bands.condition: 15-45 m height (or <15 m with area 500-1000 sqm)
15-45 m height with area 3001 sqm and above

bands.note: Refer to hydraulic-calculation note / Annex D provisions.

bands.condition: Less than 15 m height, any floor area (up to and above 1000 sqm)
15 m and above height, any floor area (up to and above 1000 sqm)

notes: If the building has a basement requiring sprinkler protection, protection level upgrades to CL-3.
If the building has EV parks in podium/basement, must be sprinklered and comply with CL-5.
Supplementary protection for specific hazard/critical rooms per Table 9/10/11 as applicable.
If building height exceeds 60 m, hydraulic calculations with multi-level pumping/storage and gravity-redundant down-comer; pumps should not exceed 12 bar shutoff pressure.
Pump pressure/quantity must be supported by hydraulic calculations.

Cluster of up to 5 buildings (not closer than 9 m): 2500 lpm at 10 bar common pumping, 255000 litre storage; or 3785 lpm at 10 bar with 350000 litre storage variant; CL-5 required if closer than 9 m or shared EV basement.
Multi-level pumping/storage per SLD (Fig. 20) for cluster buildings over 45 m; water storage at every 45 m above per building.
If cluster exceeds 5 buildings, another equivalent pump/storage set required (max 2 sets recommended).
data_centre_specific_notes: Entire data centre building must be sprinklered and comply with CL-5. IT/Data Hall may use clean-agent gas suppression only if racks are without battery backup units (BBU), or with BBU not exceeding 20 kWh.
All internet data centres, hyperscale, or colocation data centres must comply with CL-6.

If IT/data hall racks have BBUs with Lithium-ion batteries not exceeding 20 kWh/rack, wet/dry sprinkler, pre-action, or water mist (third-party tested for lithium-ion BBUs) must be deployed. If BBUs exceed 20 kWh/rack, water mist must NOT be installed.
For a cluster of up to 3 data centre buildings, a common pumping/storage system with an additional diesel engine pump and double water storage may be used.
If any building houses lithium-ion energy storage systems (BESS) exceeding 600 kWh/floor, the building must comply with CL-6.

Lithium-ion BESS rooms must be protected with wet/single-interlock pre-action sprinkler only, treating the entire room as the 'assumed area of operation'. Pump/storage sizing = max(design basis, hydraulic calculation).
